description: This file defines the DETR (DEtection TRansformer) model class and associated criterion for object detection, including model architecture, loss calculation, and post-processing. It includes class definitions for DETR, SetCriterion, PostProcess, and utility functions for building the model and loss components.

classes.name: DETR
classes.description: Neural network module implementing the DETR object detection model, integrating backbone, transformer, and prediction heads. Supports forward pass with nested tensors, auxiliary losses, and model configuration.

classes.name: SetCriterion
classes.description: Loss computation class for DETR, handling Hungarian matching, classification, box regression, and optional mask losses. Supports auxiliary losses for intermediate decoder layers.

classes.name: PostProcess
classes.description: Converts raw model outputs into structured detection results with absolute box coordinates and labels, suitable for evaluation and visualization.

classes.name: build
classes.description: Function to instantiate the DETR model and its loss criterion based on provided arguments, including backbone, transformer, matcher, and post-processors.

methods.name: _set_aux_loss(self, outputs_class, outputs_coord)
methods.description: Creates auxiliary output dictionaries for intermediate decoder layer supervision in DETR.

methods.name: loss_labels(self, outputs, targets, indices, num_boxes, log=True)
methods.description: Computes classification loss (cross-entropy) for object labels.

methods.name: loss_cardinality(self, outputs, targets, indices, num_boxes)
methods.description: Calculates the difference in predicted versus true number of objects for logging.

methods.name: loss_boxes(self, outputs, targets, indices, num_boxes)
methods.description: Computes box regression losses, including L1 loss and GIoU.

methods.name: loss_masks(self, outputs, targets, indices, num_boxes)
methods.description: Calculates mask-related losses like focal loss and dice loss for segmentation.

methods.name: get_loss(self, loss, outputs, targets, indices, num_boxes, **kwargs)
methods.description: Delegates to specific loss functions based on loss type.

methods.name: forward (SetCriterion)
methods.description: Performs the overall loss calculation for model outputs and ground-truth targets, including auxiliary losses.

methods.name: forward (PostProcess)
methods.description: Transforms raw outputs into detection results with absolute coordinates and labels.

methods.name: forward (MLP)
methods.description: Executes the multi-layer perceptron forward pass.
